objective: Verify that a transient user-systemd controller survives return/exit of its launching process, has a hard runtime and memory boundary, and ExecStopPost stops only the exact Q209-owned child service; no model, inference server, or GPU is used.

method.launcher: Two-phase test_detached_worker_lifecycle.py launch then verify; launch returns after systemd-run --user --no-block, then a separate process verifies durable marker and cleanup.
method.fake_child: /usr/bin/sleep infinity in a generated q209-lifecycle-smoke-<nonce>-child unit; MemoryMax=128M, MemorySwapMax=0, RuntimeMaxSec=300s, KillMode=control-group.
method.fake_controller: python3 writes a started marker then sleeps 30s; generated worker RuntimeMaxSec=8s, MemoryMax=128M, MemorySwapMax=0, OOMPolicy=kill, KillMode=control-group, ExecStopPost=cleanup_detached_worker.py.
method.resource_scope: CPU-only user-systemd test units, unique q209 lifecycle smoke names; no nvidia-smi, model files, network, benchmark harness, or GPU calls.
method.cleanup: Hook requires exact Q209 description and allowlisted generated unit name; verify receipt PASS_STOPPED/PASS_ALREADY_STOPPED, worker result timeout, and fake child inactive. Test finally stops only its generated fake units if any assertion fails.
method.syntax_gate: Before launching fake jobs, run python3 -m py_compile on run_q173.py, launch_detached_q173.py, cleanup_detached_worker.py, and test_detached_worker_lifecycle.py; this executes no code and touches no GPU.
method.safety_guards: The smoke launcher and verifier re-check the exact Q202 lock token before creating units. On assertion failure, the verifier records the failure first and only emergency-stops generated units whose exact Q209 smoke descriptions still match.

pass_criteria: systemd-run returns before fake worker completion
started marker is created after launcher process returned
worker terminates with Result=timeout within the preregistered limit
ExecStopPost writes a PASS receipt and the exact fake child is inactive
no GPU/model/server used and no non-test unit touched
all four Python files pass py_compile before systemd jobs start
next_gate: Synchronize this preregistration in Results row 496, read it back, then run the CPU-only lifecycle test; no GPU benchmark unless it passes.

amendments.reason: Strengthen the CPU smoke after reviewing its failure path.
changes: Re-check Q202 lock ownership in both launch and verify phases.
On failed assertions, write a failure receipt and emergency-stop only generated test units with exact matching descriptions.
